title: Baclofen for alcohol use disorder: ClinicalTrials.gov posted results only
intro: Randomized trials of baclofen against placebo with a posted drinking outcome after at least 4 weeks of treatment, from query.cond=alcohol&query.intr=baclofen, filter AREA[HasResults]true (8 records, 2026-10-15). Inclusion, outcome rule and the general/comorbid classification were committed before any outcome data were read (aud-comorbidity-prereg-2-2026-10-15.md). Dropped on reading: NCT01002105 (its only drinking outcome, percent abstinent days at one year, is posted without any SD, SE or test), NCT01751386 (its only posted outcome is a 2-hour laboratory self-administration session). That leaves one usable trial per group, so by the pre-registered rule baclofen contributes no general-vs-comorbid difference. Excluded from the listing before reading: NCT02052440, NCT01937364, NCT00597701, NCT01076283.
